user.title: Connect your Oasis lamps
user.description: Sign in to Oasis, then choose the lamps to control from Home Assistant.

export.title: Export your Oasis credentials
export.description:
On your Mac, Windows, or Linux computer, run the [guided exporter](https://github.com/LouisIV/oasis-ambient-custom-component#export-credentials-on-your-computer). Sign in on the official Oasis page; the exporter saves one file for all your lamp networks. It does not save your password or account tokens.

Keep the exported file private. Select Submit when you have the file ready to upload.

upload.title: Import credentials
upload.description: Choose the JSON file saved by the Oasis exporter. An existing mesh-export.json also works. Keys stay on your Home Assistant installation; daily control does not need the cloud.

lamps.title: Choose your lamps
lamps.description: Choose the lamps to add. Setup checks access to their Bluetooth mesh network without changing the lights. A nearby proxy does not confirm that every lamp is online.

no_new_lamps.title: No additional lamps in this export
no_new_lamps.description: No additional supported lamps were found in the loaded configuration. To check your Oasis account for newly paired lamps, close this dialog and choose Sign in to Oasis. Select Submit to import an updated file instead.

login.title: Sign in to Oasis
login.description: Use your Oasis email and password to find your lamps. Home Assistant sends them to Oasis to retrieve your lamp configuration; your password and account tokens are not saved. Daily lighting control stays local.

advanced.title: Advanced setup
advanced.description: Use a credential file if you already have one or cannot sign in here.

progress.connect_lamps: Checking your selected lamps over Bluetooth. This may take a minute for several lamps. No light settings or pairing will change.

error.invalid_export: This file could not be imported, or existing mesh keys have changed. Export again from the same Oasis account. Do not reset the lamps.
error.no_lamps: No supported lamps were found. Pair your lamps in the Oasis app, then try again.
error.select_lamps: Select at least one lamp from the list.
error.not_nearby: No reachable Bluetooth proxy was found for a selected lamp’s network. Check lamp power and Bluetooth range, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: A lamp could not connect or authenticate. Close phone Bluetooth tools, move the adapter or proxy closer, and retry. No lamps were added.
error.unsafe_mesh: The mesh configuration or saved controller state could not be used safely. Check the export and storage permissions. Do not delete sequence files to retry.
error.already_added: Another setup added one of these lamps. Choose the remaining lamps.
error.invalid_auth: Oasis could not authorize this request. Check your email and password, then try again.
error.account_unavailable: Could not reach Oasis. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: Oasis is limiting sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.invalid_account_data: Oasis returned a lamp configuration we could not read. Try again or use Advanced setup to import a credential file.
error.additional_auth_required: This account requires an additional sign-in step that is not supported here yet. Use Advanced setup and the browser-based exporter.

export.title: Export updated credentials
export.description: Run the [guided exporter](https://github.com/LouisIV/oasis-ambient-custom-component#export-credentials-on-your-computer) on your computer and sign in to Oasis. One export includes all lamp networks. Select Submit to upload the file.

upload.title: Import updated credentials
upload.description: Existing lamps and their controller counters are preserved. Importing credentials does not reset or re-pair lamps.
